title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming CBB game between Monmouth Hawks and Quinnipiac Bobcats, originally scheduled for Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 7:00 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the Monmouth Hawks win, the market will resolve to "Monmouth Hawks".
If the Quinnipiac Bobcats win, the market will resolve to "Quinnipiac Bobcats".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Saturday, November 14, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.
